name: Activity rings
summary: Three nested progress rings for move, exercise and stand, with each value against its goal, a nudge to close the first ring, and a week of small rings you can tap to see a past day.
use: on the home screen of a fitness or health app, for today's progress against daily goals
a11y: The rings are one image whose name reads every value against its goal; each day in the week strip is a button with its date as its name and aria-pressed for the day shown.
